column1: # Phase 0.5 trace v0 walk legs. One leg per row; the port and retail sides both start the body at
# the row's pose (eye convention, as tools/parity/shots.tsv) and hold forward for the same game time.
# name <TAB> level <TAB> x <TAB> y <TAB> z <TAB> pitch <TAB> yaw
# walk_cantina is route_cantina turned 180 degrees: level 1's cantina pose facing yaw 105. The port
# walks into furniture around x -3.98 and retail into its own at x -4.37, so it measures the start
# pose and the resting height but not a steady speed.
# walk_street45 is the flat straight run: 2.21 units in 3 s in the port, z within 0.01, four sectors.
# RETAIL STOPS at (3.270, -1.860, 0.620) sector 155 - the fixture's measurement target. Nothing with a
# model is in the body's way there (the nearest crate is 0.8 away and the nearest actor is 1.1 below
# the feet), so the stop is level geometry the port lacks: without blocking the port walks past it and
# falls to the spawn (sector 339). Do not re-try a thing-obstacle patch for this leg (rounds 15-23).
# Retail crosses 271 -> 157 -> 155; the port keeps going and steps
# off a ledge there, so the leg also measures that collision difference (thing collision is absent).
walk_cantina
walk_street45
# walk_street90 is the yaw-mapping probe (round 30; the yaw-0 half served its purpose and
# had no fixture, so it is not a capture leg). Retail at yaw 90 walks pure -x
# nudges +0.04 in y and stops: that is exactly the decompiled basis `forward = (-sin a, cos a)`, so
# the port and retail share a movement basis. walk_street90 is the cleanest straight leg yet - no
# blocking, no drift, three sectors.
walk_street90
# walk_switch: from the switch-side warp, walk south into the cantina door switch thing (cog 11).
# Phase 1 step 4's positional trigger probe: the use key did nothing from 0.8 units, so the switch
# is expected to fire on touch (thing link) rather than on use.
walk_switch
# walk_door0: warp on the upper floor south of the level-1 door (cog 0, thing 4 at 1.20,9.65,6.35),
# face north and walk through its adjoin. Phase 1 step 4's door trigger: `crossed` should move
# `doorstatus`/`movestatus` in cog 0, which `cogstatus 0` reports.
walk_door0
# walk_exitdoor: the authored `walkplayer` placement 174 (eye 1.400084, 9.700065, 6.357114), facing
# the door piece (thing 4 at 1.200002, 9.650073, 6.35; yaw 105 is the direction retail's own coords
# records there, and the port's forward basis `(-sin, cos)` faces the door from it). The forward
# hold stops at the shut sector-74 portal; `-UseAfterWalk SPACE` then presses the player's ACTIVATE
# binding, and the post-walk `cogstatus 0` reports `doorstatus`/`movestatus`.
walk_exitdoor
# walk5_spawn: Phase 2's second non-level-1 probe. level5_spawn's pose (the debug list's entry 5 boots
# 06abarons); that reference is a static player-camera frame, so the spawn should be calm.
